name: aurevoy
description: Aurevoy — 让每个人都拥有属于自己的 AI Agent。通用个人 AI Agent 桌面产品。

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run prepare-agent-deps && concurrently -n agent,desktop -c blue,green "npm:dev:agent" "npm:dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aurevoy/shared && npm run build -w @aurevoy/agent && npm run build -w @aurevoy/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
